_comment: THE INSCRIBER PRESSES, and only when AE2 is installed (#268).
AE2 cannot be progressed at all in this world. Its tree hangs off Sky Stone, Sky Stone comes
from meteorites, and meteorites gate on #ae2:has_meteorites -> #minecraft:is_overworld, which
matches nothing here - this mod ships no is_overworld entry, by owner ruling. The four presses
have no other source: AE2's own recipes for them take the SAME press as the stamp, so they
duplicate a press rather than make one.
A TAG ENTRY, NOT FOUR ITEM ENTRIES, and that is what makes the guard unnecessary. An item id in
a loot table resolves against the registry when the file is parsed, so naming ae2:silicon_press
without AE2 breaks the whole table. A TagKey does not resolve at parse time and an absent tag
rolls to nothing, so this pool is simply empty without AE2. That is asserted by
the_sump_is_unchanged_without_ae2, which runs in exactly that state.
expand:false yields EVERY item in the tag at once rather than picking one. That is AE2's own
mechanism, copied from its mysterious_cube loot table, and it is what its guide describes: the
four presses come from ONE find. Using AE2's tag also means a fifth processor press would be
carried here the day AE2 adds it, and that name_press is excluded because AE2 excludes it.
IN THE SUMP RATHER THAN THE BARRELS, which is a correction to #268. The barrels roll
chests/sewer twice per access chamber and a sewer has several, so 'one press set per sewer'
cannot be expressed there. The sump crate is one per sewer - it is already the echo shard's
home and the reason to go to the BOTTOM of one - so it is the only table that can say it.
GUARANTEED, like the shard beside it. A gate that is random is a bad gate, and this is stricter
than AE2 intends already: it calls meteorites 'fairly common', while a sewer is one per ~250
chunks of demolition yard, behind a Prybar.
TEMPORARY. This is pack content living in the engine because the pack cannot ship data on
26.1.2. When KubeJS is fixed it moves out - Flatts3000/trashlands#46. Deleting this pool is the
whole removal.
